feeding_claim.verbatim: Grass-fed means that none of our beef critters receive any type of processed grain.

resold_note: Also sells turkeys from Back Acres Farm, chicken and raw milk from Grace Pond Farm, and cheese, yogurt, butter, ice cream and other goods from other Maine producers.
notes: Checked the homepage, our meat page, farm store page and FAQ. The FAQ says the beef is 100% grass-fed with no processed grain, on pasture in summer and the farm's own hay and haylage in winter; pigs and chickens get a non-GMO grain ration. Beef cattle are bought in as yearling calves from Maine and regional farms and grazed here; piglets are bought from another Maine farm. Flock size was cut back and the farm partners with Grace Pond Farm to keep pastured chicken in the store, so the Verifier may want to confirm poultry is still raised on the ranch. Farm store open Wednesday 2 to 6, Thursday 12 to 4, Friday 2 to 6, Saturday 12 to 4. The store page says they do not ship. Sides and whole beef and pork are sold through the wholesale preorder page; the FAQ says a side and a half are the same. The homepage mentions a modified CSA system, recorded as csa. Feeding quote came from a WebFetch summary of the FAQ.
